content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's Degree in Economics or MBA Degree (preferably in Finance/Economics/Public Policy) from a reputed and recognized University or Institution; minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in the specified areas. Experience: Essential: Minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in handling financial and accounting matters as per Government of India rules, GFR/DFPR procedures, e-Office, MS Office including Advance MS-Excel, PFMS and GeM Portals, Central Sector Schemes, budget and scheme documents, Audit Paras, RTI and grievance replies, DPR/BAR evaluation, incentive claims and coordination with MeitY, Line Ministries, DoNER and NITI Aayog. Desirable: Court matters related to Govt. Schemes/policies. Age limit: Below 35 years (as on date of closing of application) Other conditions: Proficiency in e-Office (Noting and Drafting), MS Office including Advance MS-Excel, PFMS Portal and GeM Portal is part of the essential experience Relaxation on work experience may be given as per Guidelines on fulfilling special criteria and experience of working in similar domain Desirable: Work experience in dealing with Court matters related to Govt. Schemes / policies etc.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contractual engagement for 03 years on full time basis Continuation for up to additional 2 years will be considered on case-to-case basis by Competent Authority; no right to demand extension Performance based annual increment may be granted after completion of a year, subject to approval of competent authority DPIIT can cancel the appointment at any time; normally 15 days' notice or remuneration in lieu on pro rata basis Junior Consultant can seek termination on giving 15 days' notice to DPIIT No right to any permanent position or job in DPIIT

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DPIIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DPIIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Consultant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DPIIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 14 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 35 years (as on date of closing of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 0.6 - 1.00 Lakhs per month (consolidated), based on suitability and experience of candidate.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree in Economics or MBA Degree (preferably in Finance/Economics/Public Policy) from a reputed and recognized University or Institution, with minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in the specified financial, scheme and government-procedure areas.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Proficiency in e-Office (Noting and Drafting), MS Office including Advance MS-Excel, PFMS Portal and GeM Portal is part of the essential experience. Relaxation on work experience may be given as per Guidelines on fulfilling special criteria and experience of working in similar domain.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening of applications for qualification and completeness. Shortlisting of complete applications. Interview in Physical Mode in Delhi by the Consultancy Evaluation Committee. Applications screened for qualification and completeness; incomplete ones summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contractual engagement for 03 years on full time basis. Continuation for up to additional 2 years will be considered on case-to-case basis by Competent Authority; no right to demand extension. Performance based annual increment may be granted after completion of a year, subject to approval of competent authority.

faq.answer: New Delhi.
